title: Window Project Size Step on Door Bundles
content:
# Window Project Size Step on Door Bundles

Window Replacement Contracts. A window-project step is added to the window series bundle percentage by the openings the completed final measure confirmed on this contract (the largest count should more than one completed final measure be recorded): at least 20 openings (the large window-project opening count) adds the large window step of 0.01; at least 10 openings (the mid window-project opening count) but fewer than 20 adds the mid window step of 0.005; fewer openings, or a contract not yet measured, adds nothing.

The step is added to the window series bundle percentage, and the sum is the bundle rate at which the credit is figured.

| Openings confirmed at the completed final measure | Step added |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | 0.01 |
| 10 to 19 | 0.005 |
| 9 or fewer | 0 |
| Not yet measured | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- Final measure confirmed 19 openings: 0.005; 20 openings: 0.01.
- Contract still signed with 25 openings on it and no completed final measure: 0.
